source_campaign: T001 - Котки: банер за one click upsell курса

banners.prompt:
The FIRST input image is only a blank canvas. The SECOND input image shows the printed book with its front cover (for style and cats reference only).
Create a landscape banner for an online video course on a sales page, FULL BLEED, no white margins.
BACKGROUND: light sky blue #DCEEFB fading to white, soft light, subtle paw-print pattern.
LAYOUT: on the left half a big text block; on the right half a modern laptop, slightly angled, showing a video lesson on screen: a black-and-white kitten and a grey tomcat (the same cats as on the book cover) on a scratching post, with a big round yellow-orange play button in the middle of the video and a progress bar. On the laptop corner sits a small black graduation cap with a gold tassel.
TEXT (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Small label at the top, yellow-orange pill with dark navy text: "ВИДЕО КУРС"
2) Title line 1, dark navy, very big: "КОТЕШКАТА"
3) Title line 2, dark navy, very big: "АКАДЕМИЯ"
4) Title line 3, yellow-orange, very big: "P.U.R.R."
5) Subtitle, dark navy, medium: "спокойна и възпитана котка за 30 дни"
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, modern; palette dark navy #0F2A4A, warm yellow-orange #F5A623, light sky blue #DCEEFB and white.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "P.U.R.R.". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character. Do not translate, correct, shorten or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style), large and legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices or website addresses anywhere (no text inside the laptop screen).
CATS: ordinary domestic cats, natural anatomy. NO people, no faces.
